commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Liam Rosenior decides to make a substitution. Malo Gusto will be replaced by Josh Acheampong (Chelsea).
90+2' Jack Hinshelwood goes off the pitch and Matt O'Riley (Brighton) comes on.
90+1' 3 - 0 What a hit! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the top of the net. 3:0.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
87' Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul after Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) hacks down one of his opponents.
83' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) replaces Georginio Rutter.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kaoru Mitoma trots off the pitch and is replaced by Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
82' Flag up against Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
81' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
80' Marc Guiu (Chelsea) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Good work from Chelsea as they win a corner.
77' Here comes a substitution. Yankuba Minteh is given a rest as he is replaced by Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton).

77' Nice move, nice attempt! Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
74' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) brought his opponent down.
73' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dario Essugo (Chelsea) replacing Romeo Lavia.
72' The substitution is prepared. Marc Guiu (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Liam Delap.
71' Pascal Gross (Brighton) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.
70' The corner from Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is intercepted by the defence.
70' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Chelsea get a corner.
68' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
68' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) does well to meet the corner from Pascal Gross, but his close-range header is soft and goes miles wide of the right post.
67' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner.

67' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) finds some space after collecting a superb pass and unleashes a shot directly towards the top left corner. Despite his effort the goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.

66' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom right corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Robert Sanchez. Brighton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
63' Craig Pawson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pascal Gross (Brighton) and blew his whistle.
62' Wasted opportunity. Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
62' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
62' A cross into the box from Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.
60' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
58' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
56' 2 - 0 Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
54' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
50' Rough tackle by Carlos Baleba (Brighton). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Craig Pawson blows his whistle for an infringement.
47' Romeo Lavia (Chelsea) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Fabian Hurzeler probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mats Wieffer. He is replaced by Joel Veltman (Brighton).
46' Here's the change. Wesley Fofana leaves the pitch and Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) comes on as a substitute.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+1' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' The referee blows his whistle as Georginio Rutter (Brighton) was too aggressive in his challenge.
43' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
41' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

40' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The referee blows his whistle, Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
39' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

39' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brighton.
37' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robert Sanchez intercepts the ball.
33' Liam Delap (Chelsea) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Craig Pawson blows for a foul after Liam Delap (Chelsea) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
30' Poor challenge! Pascal Gross (Brighton) is penalised for tripping and Craig Pawson blows his whistle.
27' Pascal Gross (Brighton) jumps into a tackle and Craig Pawson signals a foul.
26' Total attempts – 7:0.
25' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

24' Liam Delap (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
23' Robert Sanchez leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Pascal Gross (Brighton).
23' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play and Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Pascal Gross (Brighton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robert Sanchez, who smothers the ball.
20' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off his line to gather the ball.
17' That was close by Georginio Rutter (Brighton)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
16' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) brings an opponent down and Craig Pawson interrupts the game.
16' Brighton take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

15' Robert Sanchez pulls off a fantastic save! Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out. Brighton will take a corner kick.
12' A clumsy foul by Georginio Rutter (Brighton) and Craig Pawson blows his whistle.
11' This shall not pass! Georginio Rutter (Brighton) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
9' Liam Delap (Chelsea) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation.
7' The linesman signals that Liam Delap (Chelsea) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
6' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Craig Pawson stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:0.
3' Now Brighton have a corner.

3' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Robert Sanchez produces a wonderful reflex save. The linesman makes the right call and Brighton will have a corner.
2' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
2' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brighton will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Craig Pawson.
